 Shipp's Dockside Grill: Your Premier Waterfront Seafood Restaurant at Orange Beach Marina

 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
 
 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 

 
 

 
 The Shipp family returns to Orange Beach with two distinct culinary experiences: dockside seafood and sushi on the lower deck and Chef Matt’s signature dishes with craft cocktails on the upscale yet relaxed upper deck.

meta.description:
Experience Shipp's Dockside Grill, the premier seafood restaurant in Orange 
Beach. Delight in our extensive menu, showcasing fresh seafood, tender 
steaks, and exquisite sushi. Choose between casual counter service on the 
Lower Deck or family-friendly full-service dining on the Upper Deck, all 
with breathtaking views of Orange Beach Marina.
